The structure of Ba4Ca2Sn2O10 (reduced formula Ba2CaSnO5) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 18 atoms in the unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Sn each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ba adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors. The oxygen environments involve Ca, Sn, and Ba neighbors, with distances ranging from about 2.30 to 3.26 Å. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between 6-vertex Ca and 12-vertex Ba polyhedra, and face-sharing between Ba and Sn polyhedra; the neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
